'''XR''' was the personal [[Droid/Legends|droid]] assistant of [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Akary Smith]]. However, it ended up reprogrammed and armed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Koong (general)|Koong]], and was tasked with capturing Smith, [[Jann Tosh]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. However, R2 managed to outsmart the droid.
